# Abdul Qadir Avedia

> Abdul Qadir Avedia is a Finance & Accounts Executive based in Karachi, Pakistan, with 4+ years of experience in financial reconciliation, receivables management, payroll, Power BI dashboards (DAX), QuickBooks Online and financial modeling. He is also a self-taught graphic designer (logos, brand identity, print and social media). He is open to freelance, project-based and full-time opportunities.

Quick facts (from his portfolio, last updated 2026-11-26):
- Name: Abdul Qadir Avedia
- Location: Karachi, Sindh, Pakistan (works with clients remotely)
- Current role: Accountant & Client Coordinator, Sir Adamjee Institute (since Apr 2025)
- Education: MBA in Finance, Bahria University (from Jan 2026); BBA in Finance, Sindh Madressatul Islam University (2021-2025, CGPA 3.21)
- Core tools: Power BI + DAX, Microsoft Excel, QuickBooks Online, MySQL, ERP systems, Monday.com; Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Canva Pro
- Availability: open to freelance finance and design work
- Contact: abdul.qadir.avedia1@gmail.com | https://www.linkedin.com/in/abdul-qadir-avadia | contact form at https://mr-avedia.github.io/Abdul-Qadir/#contact
